evidence.claim: The Pro Tech Toolkit is listed at $79.95.
The kit centers on a 64 Bit Driver Kit with CNC-machined bits selected for current and legacy consumer-electronics fasteners; its magnetic lid doubles as a sorting tray.
evidence.verbatim: At the core of this kit is the iFixit 64 Bit Driver Kit, designed with extensive research into what fastener types are currently used in the consumer electronics industry and which legacy fasteners are still in demand by consumers. From the Apple Watch with its new tiny Tri-Point screws to vintage Nintendo game consoles with gamebit fasteners, the 64 bit kit covers them all with the highest quality CNC machined bits. Even the sturdy case was carefully engineered, having no hinges or latches to break, and features a sorting tray inside the magnetically attached lid.

evidence.claim: Beyond the driver kit, the toolkit includes tweezers, spudgers, opening tools, and anti-static safety accessories.
evidence.verbatim: We curated an assortment of our most popular tweezers, spudgers, opening tools, and anti-static safety accessories for everyday use.

evidence.claim: The toolkit includes a magnetic case, foam insert, and fabric roll for storage and portability.
evidence.verbatim: A magnetic case and foam insert ensure secure storage, while the inside of the lid serves as a sorting tray. Take it with you anywhere with the included fabric roll.

evidence.claim: The Pro Tech Toolkit product page identifies a Lifetime Guarantee.
The Lifetime Guarantee promises that the product will function for as long as the customer has it.
evidence.verbatim:
\* **Lifetime Guarantee (Full Guarantee)**

- This iFixit product is guaranteed to function as long as you have it.

evidence.claim: Claims may be denied for abuse, negligence, unintended use, cosmetic issues, loss, installation damage, accidental damage, misuse, device damage, or data loss; iFixit may require the product back for analysis and does not reimburse third-party costs.
evidence.verbatim: Our policy is to honor guarantee claims within the guarantee period, unless the defect is caused by owner/user abuse or negligence or if the product was not used as intended. We may require you to return a product for analysis prior to issuance of a credit or replacement. **iFixit is not liable for reimbursing third party costs** as we facilitate customers to be able to do repairs themselves to save on labor.

evidence.claim: Consumable items in the Pro Tech Toolkit have an “as-is” guarantee rather than lifetime replacement, while the other tools and parts remain covered.
evidence.verbatim: Some products, like batteries, are designed to be consumed during use. Product pages will tell you what items are designed to be consumed during use. Items like the Pro Tech Toolkit have consumable products that are covered under their own “as-is” guarantee. Those consumables won’t get lifetime guarantee replacement, but the other tools and parts will be covered.

evidence.claim: A claim requires order and contact information, shipping details, evidence of the issue, affected-bit details when applicable, and the guarantee request form; third-party purchases must be handled through that platform.
evidence.verbatim:
### Step 1 — Gather your information

Before starting your request, please make sure you have the following details ready:

- **Order number** – You can find this in your confirmation email or under **Orders** in your account.
- **Full name and shipping address** – We’ll confirm this before sending any replacement.
- **Contact details** – Include your email address for communication and a phone number if required by the shipping carrier.
- **Photos or video of the issue** – Show the defective item clearly. For shipping damage, include the box, packing materials, and the item itself.
- **If bits are affected** – List exactly which bits need replacing.
- **If purchased through a third party** – Include a photo of the complete kit or tool set.

### Step 2 — Start your guarantee request

Once you have your information ready, please fill out our [guarantee request form](https://www.ifixit.com/Support/cs-form/guarantee). It asks a few quick questions and collects everything our team needs to review your claim.

👉 If you purchased through a third party such as Amazon, please start the return or guarantee process directly through that platform.

evidence.claim: Replacement shipping costs can vary by region; cross-shipping requires a valid credit card, and iFixit may charge the retail price if the defective product is not returned within 30 days after receipt of the replacement.
evidence.verbatim:
In most cases, we will cross-ship guarantee replacements for defective parts and tools. This simply means that we will send you a replacement item and we expect to receive the defective item back.

In some cases, we may require you to ship the failed item back to us before we send your replacement. Shipping costs for guarantee replacements may vary by region. See our [Guarantee Request](/Info/Guarantee_Request) page for details.

To cross-ship, we must have a valid credit card number on file to cover any incidentals. If we do not receive the defective product back after 30 days from the date you receive the replacement, we reserve the right to charge your credit card for the retail price of the non-returned product.

evidence.claim: Defective or malfunctioning parts are replaced at no charge, but a returned fully functional item can incur a restocking fee of 15% or $5, whichever is greater.
evidence.verbatim: Before making a claim for a defective part, please test it thoroughly. If a fully-functional item is returned, it is subject to a restocking fee of 15% or $5, whichever is greater. iFixit will replace any defective or malfunctioning part at no charge; if the part is no longer available or ineligible for replacement, we will provide a return label to send back the defective part for a full refund.

assets.title: What 64 bits don’t tell you
assets.content:
Subject: What 64 bits don’t tell you
Preview text: Check the opening, handling, and anti-static tools alongside the driver set.

Choose by repair range, not bit count

Hi there,

A 64-bit count tells you how many bits are included. It does not tell you whether a kit also covers opening enclosures, handling small parts, or working around static-sensitive electronics.

The iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit combines 64 precision bits with a curated assortment of tweezers, spudgers, opening tools, and anti-static safety accessories. That makes it more than a larger driver set.

Its stated device range spans electronics, gaming consoles, drones, RC cars, and vintage devices. If that resembles the projects you want to explore, the added tool categories may fit. If your plans are narrower, the same details can help you spot unnecessary breadth.

The product page lets you compare the included tool categories, bit count, and stated device range with the repair work you expect to take on.

Review the Pro Tech Toolkit →

- the iFixit team

assets.title: After the screws come out
assets.content:
Subject: After the screws come out
Preview text: The included Jimmy gives you a purpose-built blade for the prying step that may follow.

See what Jimmy is built to do

Hi there,

When a repair step calls for prying, a precision driver has finished its part. The next move may require a thin blade made for that task.

The iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit includes Jimmy, a prying tool with a flexible steel blade and an ergonomic handle. That pairing is designed for precise, powerful prying when the repair calls for it.

This is what an additional opening tool can provide beyond removing fasteners: a specific tool for a specific kind of access work. That does not mean Jimmy suits every device or opening step.

On the product page, you can see Jimmy among the included tools and access iFixit’s care-and-use guide for details about the kit’s components. Use that information to decide whether purpose-built prying tools belong in your first general repair toolkit.

View the Pro Tech Toolkit →

- the iFixit team

assets.title: If an iFixit tool breaks
assets.content:
Subject: If an iFixit tool breaks
Preview text: The $79.95 toolkit comes with a stated lifetime guarantee and replacement commitment.

Factor replacement into the toolkit price

Hi there,

A first general repair toolkit has an upfront cost. What happens if one of its tools later breaks is another part of that purchase decision.

The iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit is a general electronics repair toolkit listed at $79.95. It carries a lifetime guarantee, and iFixit states that it will replace an iFixit tool if it breaks.

That replacement commitment is the longer-term support to weigh against the price. Its scope stays specific to an iFixit tool that breaks.

The product page lets you confirm the current price and review the toolkit’s stated lifetime guarantee before deciding whether that commitment justifies the cost for you.

See the price and guarantee →

- the iFixit team

brief.interpretation: A pre-purchase sales nurture sequence for opted-in electronics hobbyists who are considering their first general repair toolkit. Each email helps them make a progressively more informed purchase decision; this is not customer onboarding.
brief.reader:
Selected audience (user-stated constraints): Opted-in electronics hobbyists considering their first general repair toolkit.
No further recipient situation is established. Compiled market context is research to check for applicability, not a replacement biography.
brief.reader_segment: A hands-on electronics owner who is tired of improvising tools across phones, laptops, consoles, and household devices
brief.reader_profile_override: Opted-in electronics hobbyists considering their first general repair toolkit
brief.promise: The Pro Tech Toolkit is a broad first repair toolkit worth considering when the reader expects to work across device types and needs precision bits, opening tools, handling tools, and anti-static accessories in one organized kit.
brief.orientation: The Pro Tech Toolkit is a general-purpose electronics repair kit that combines a 64-bit precision driver set with tools for opening, prying, gripping, and anti-static work.
brief.arc: First determine whether the toolkit's breadth matches the reader's likely repair range, then make that breadth tangible through one included tool and its concrete use, and finally address the concern that a first toolkit may not last long enough to justify its price.
brief.sequence_rationale: Fit comes first because a broad toolkit is useful only if its device range and tool mix match the reader's ambitions. The second email turns an abstract inventory into a practical repair action by explaining the included Jimmy. The final email addresses purchase durability with the stated price, lifetime guarantee, and replacement commitment. No urgency or deadline is introduced because none is needed or supported. Each email can stand alone and links to the same product page for the relevant decision.

emails.job: Help the reader decide whether the Pro Tech Toolkit is appropriately broad for the kinds of repairs they want to undertake.
emails.single_idea: The Pro Tech Toolkit is a credible fit when the reader wants to work across electronics, consoles, drones, RC cars, and vintage devices and expects to need opening and handling tools as well as precision bits.
emails.felt_need: I want a first toolkit that can stay useful as I move between different electronics, without buying a narrowly useful kit for every new project.
emails.status_quo: A shopper may compare general repair kits mainly by bit count while still needing to determine whether each kit covers the non-screw work inside a device.
emails.why_it_fails: Bit count alone does not show whether a kit also provides tools for opening enclosures, manipulating small parts, or working around static-sensitive electronics.
emails.mechanism: The Pro Tech Toolkit pairs 64 precision bits with a curated assortment of tweezers, spudgers, opening tools, and anti-static safety accessories, and its stated device range spans electronics, gaming consoles, drones, RC cars, and vintage devices.
emails.belief_shift: Before: a 64-bit kit sounds like a larger screwdriver set. After: the reader sees it as a broader repair system and can judge whether that breadth matches their intended work.
must_not_say: Do not claim the toolkit contains every tool required for every repair.
Do not promise compatibility with an unnamed device or repair.
Do not discuss the lifetime guarantee or replacement policy; email 3 owns that argument.
Do not frame the reader as a professional or repair-business buyer.
emails.objection: I cannot tell whether I need a broad 64-bit toolkit or would be overbuying for my first repairs.
emails.call_to_action: View the Pro Tech Toolkit product page at https://www.ifixit.com/products/pro-tech-toolkit to review its 64-bit set, additional repair tools, and stated device range.
emails.next_step_decision: Decide whether the toolkit's breadth matches the range of devices and repair tasks the reader expects to explore.
emails.next_step_value: The page lets the reader inspect the included tool categories, bit count, and supported device range instead of choosing from the product name alone.
emails.next_step_limit: The page does not establish that the kit contains every tool or part required by a particular repair; the relevant repair guide still needs to be checked.
emails.subject_strategy: Invite a quick fit check based on repair range, making clear that the question is whether the reader needs more than a driver set.

emails.job: Show how one included tool addresses a concrete task encountered after a device's screws have been removed.
emails.single_idea: The included Jimmy gives the reader a purpose-built flexible steel blade and ergonomic handle for precise, powerful prying.
emails.felt_need: Removing the screws is only one part of getting into an electronic device; I may also need a controlled way to pry.
emails.mechanism: For a repair step that calls for prying with a thin steel blade, the reader can use the included Jimmy's flexible blade and ergonomic handle. The product page also links to iFixit's care-and-use guide for details about the toolkit's components.
emails.belief_shift: Before: the extra opening tools are just names in an inventory. After: the reader understands one specific job the included Jimmy is designed to perform.
must_not_say: Do not claim Jimmy is appropriate for every enclosure, adhesive, screen, or repair step.
Do not promise damage-free opening or a successful repair.
Do not turn the email into a catalogue of all included tools or bits.
Do not introduce price, returns, shipping, or guarantee terms.
emails.objection: I understand why I might need precision bits, but I am less sure what the additional opening tools are for.
emails.tone: Hands-on, specific, and instructional without sounding like a complete repair guide.
emails.call_to_action: View the Pro Tech Toolkit product page at https://www.ifixit.com/products/pro-tech-toolkit to see the included Jimmy and access the linked care-and-use information for the kit's components.
emails.next_step_decision: Decide whether a toolkit with purpose-built prying tools is more suitable than purchasing a precision driver set alone.
emails.next_step_value: The page identifies Jimmy as included and links to further care-and-use details about the toolkit's components.
emails.next_step_limit: The product page does not replace the repair guide for a specific device or establish that Jimmy is the correct tool for every opening step.
emails.subject_strategy: Lead with the moment after the screws come out and make one unfamiliar included tool immediately understandable.
must_not_reuse: The Pro Tech Toolkit is a credible fit when the reader wants to work across electronics, consoles, drones, RC cars, and vintage devices and expects to need opening and handling tools as well as precision bits.

emails.job: Resolve the supported concern that a $79.95 first toolkit may not remain useful long enough to justify buying it.
emails.single_idea: The $79.95 Pro Tech Toolkit is backed by a lifetime guarantee, and iFixit states that it will replace an iFixit tool if it breaks.
emails.felt_need: If I am spending $79.95 on my first general repair toolkit, I want to know what supports the tools beyond the first few projects.
emails.mechanism: iFixit attaches a lifetime guarantee to the Pro Tech Toolkit and states that a broken iFixit tool will be replaced, giving the reader a documented durability commitment to weigh against the purchase price.
emails.belief_shift: Before: the toolkit may feel like an uncertain $79.95 purchase for occasional repairs. After: the reader can evaluate that price alongside a stated lifetime guarantee and replacement commitment.
must_not_say: Do not invent a discount, deadline, or cart activity.
Do not imply that every kind of loss, misuse, wear, or device damage is covered.
Do not guarantee that the toolkit will complete a repair successfully.
Do not repeat the device-range or Jimmy arguments from earlier emails.
emails.objection: I do not want to pay $79.95 for tools that may only last through one or two repairs.
emails.call_to_action: View the Pro Tech Toolkit product page at https://www.ifixit.com/products/pro-tech-toolkit to confirm the current $79.95 price and review the stated lifetime guarantee before deciding whether to buy.
emails.next_step_decision: Decide whether the documented guarantee and replacement commitment make the toolkit's price reasonable for the reader's expected use.
emails.next_step_value: The product page presents the toolkit's price and lifetime-guarantee status at the point where the reader can review the product and purchase options.
emails.next_step_limit: The guarantee does not promise a successful repair or protection against damage to a device, and the email must not broaden its coverage beyond iFixit's stated terms.
emails.subject_strategy: Put the longevity question ahead of the sale by connecting the purchase price to the documented lifetime guarantee.
must_not_reuse: The Pro Tech Toolkit is a credible fit when the reader wants to work across electronics, consoles, drones, RC cars, and vintage devices and expects to need opening and handling tools as well as precision bits.
The included Jimmy gives the reader a purpose-built flexible steel blade and ergonomic handle for precise, powerful prying.

brief.voice_notes: Use short, practical sentences and iFixit's repair-first vocabulary. Address the reader as “you,” avoid greetings and signatures, and keep light repair wordplay subordinate to the evidence.
